title: Settings
subtitle: Accounts, game, launcher, appearance and your data.

ownership.checkFailed: Microsoft could not be reached. Try again later.

microsoft.title: Microsoft accounts
microsoft.description: Owning the game is required to play. Rustic checks it with Microsoft and never sees your password.
microsoft.keychain: Sign-in tokens are stored in your system keychain, never in a file or on a command line.
microsoft.step1: Open the Microsoft page in your browser (or on another device).
microsoft.step2: Enter the code below and sign in.
microsoft.step3: Come back here: the launcher continues by itself.
microsoft.waiting: Waiting for you to sign in in the browser…
microsoft.ownershipMissing: This account does not own the game.

expired.title: The code expired
expired.body: Codes are valid for 15 minutes. Start again to get a new one.

denied.title: Sign-in was cancelled
denied.body: Microsoft reported that the sign-in was refused.

no_ownership.title: This account does not own the game
no_ownership.body: Rustic only launches the game for accounts that own Minecraft: Java Edition.

error.title: Sign-in failed
error.body: Rustic could not finish the sign-in. Try again; if it keeps failing, the detail below tells why.

not_configured.title: Microsoft sign-in is not set up in this build
not_configured.body: This build has no Azure application id, so it cannot ask Microsoft to verify the game licence. Official builds include it.

not_approved.title: The launcher is waiting for Mojang’s approval
not_approved.body: Your Microsoft account signed in, but the game services do not accept this launcher yet: Mojang must first approve its application id. Nothing to do on your side; try again once it is approved.

xbox.title: Xbox Live refused the sign-in
xbox.body: The reason is below (child account without parental permission, Xbox profile to create, unsupported region…).

rate_limited.title: Too many attempts
rate_limited.body: The services received too many sign-ins in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

network.title: Could not reach the services
network.body: Check your internet connection and try again.

rustic.title: Rustic account
rustic.description: Your Rustic identity for friends, the Locker, purchases and servers.
rustic.signedOut: Not signed in. The game works without it; social features, the Locker and the Store need it.
rustic.signIn: Sign in or create an account
rustic.licenceNote: A Rustic account is a platform identity. It never replaces the game licence: you still need a Microsoft account that owns the game.

offline.title: Offline play
offline.description: For LAN parties and playing without internet: you play with your Microsoft account, under your official name and UUID. Available for {{days}} days after the last successful ownership check, then Rustic asks Microsoft again.
offline.locked: Sign in with a Microsoft account that owns the game first: offline play opens after a successful ownership check.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Services the launcher uses on your behalf. Keys and host fingerprints stay in your system keychain.
connections.porkbunHint: Used to create DNS records for your servers on your own Porkbun account.
connections.porkbunRemoved: Porkbun keys removed from this computer
connections.vpsHint: Servers you host on your own VPS over SSH. Forgetting a host removes its pinned key.

linked.notLinked: Not linked: sign in to Rustic with your Microsoft account too.
linked.lastMethod: Add a password first (on the website): Microsoft is your only way to sign in.

memory.title: Memory (RAM)
memory.description: Default memory given to the game. Each instance can override it.
memory.warn: This leaves little memory to your system and may slow everything down.
memory.perInstance: Tip: 4 GB is plenty for most instances; large modpacks may want 6 to 8 GB.

prepare.title: Game files
prepare.description: Horizon prepares the game's resources from your own installation of the game. Nothing is downloaded from third parties.
prepare.sourceHint: The official launcher's game folder found on this computer.

steps.download: Downloading the game files from Mojang…

prepare.legal: The prepared files stay on this computer and are never shared.

java.label: Java for preparation
java.description: Only used to prepare game files (horizon-prepare). Horizon itself does not need Java to run.

rusticServer.title: Rustic Server
rusticServer.description: The rustic-server program your Rustic Server servers run (Horizon’s engine with Rustic plugins). It must come from the same Horizon commit as the server’s game version: a Rustic edition build ships it in its folder.
rusticServer.notFoundHint: Install a Rustic edition build that ships it, or choose the rustic-server file. Without it, creating a Rustic Server fails.
rusticServer.configuredMissing: The chosen file no longer exists: {{path}}
rusticServer.invalid: This file is not a rustic-server program (it does not answer --rustic-version).
rusticServer.failed: This program could not be saved
rusticServer.order: Lookup order: your choice, then the game version’s folder, then beside the launcher, then the PATH.

folders.title: Folders
folders.description: Where the launcher keeps its data, your instances and your servers.
folders.moveNote: Existing files are not moved automatically.

resolution.title: Game window
resolution.description: Default window size for new instances.

native.title: Native mods
native.description: Instances with native mods play a game compiled for them on this PC. Here: the Rust compiler and the compile cache that makes later builds fast.
native.rustMissing: Rust {{version}} is needed for the first build.
native.cacheDetail: Cache {{cache}} · downloaded crates {{crates}} · Rust {{toolchain}} · source {{source}}. Clearing it keeps the built games; the next build recompiles everything.
native.clearBody: Instances keep their built game. The next native build compiles the whole game again (10 to 15 minutes).
native.limitHint: After a build, the cache is cleared when it is larger than this (0: never).
native.limitInvalid: The limit is a whole number of GiB from 0 to 4096.

language.title: Language
language.description: Applies at once to the whole launcher.
language.label: Language
language.help: Texts not translated yet show in English. Translations come from the community.

startup.title: Startup
startup.onBoot: Open Rustic when the computer starts
startup.onBootHint: Friends see you online sooner and updates download in the background.

behaviour.title: While playing
behaviour.onCloseHint: Keeping it in the tray lets friends invite you and servers keep running.

updates.title: Updates
updates.autoHint: Updates are signed and verified before installing.
updates.deferred: Waiting for the game to close
updates.lastError: The last attempt failed. It will be retried automatically.

performance.title: Downloads & performance
performance.downloadsHint: Lower it on a slow connection.
performance.hardwareHint: Turn off if the launcher flickers. Takes effect after a restart.

theme.title: Theme
theme.description: Rustic is designed dark first; the light theme is there for bright rooms.
theme.label: Theme

palette.title: Palette
palette.description: The accent colour used for PLAY, selection and progress.
palette.label: Palette

motion.title: Motion
motion.body: Rustic follows your system’s “reduce motion” setting: animations, the carousel and the 3D preview become still.

telemetry.title: What you share with us
telemetry.description: Everything here is off by default. Turning something on helps us improve Rustic; you can change your mind at any time.
telemetry.usageHint: Which pages and features are used, without content or identifiers.
telemetry.performanceHint: Launch times and frame times, to find slow spots.
telemetry.crashHint: When off, Rustic asks you each time a crash happens.

social.title: Friends and presence
social.activity: Show what I play to my friends
social.activityHint: Lets friends see your server and join you in one click.
social.requests: Who can send me friend requests
social.discoverable: Appear in suggestions of players I meet
social.discoverableHint: Players you shared a party with or met on a server you share in your activity can see you in “Add a friend”, and you see them. Kept 30 days; turning this off deletes it.
social.discoverableFailed: This setting could not be saved.
social.discordHint: "Playing Rustic" on your Discord profile: in the launcher, on the main menu, in singleplayer or on a server, with your play time.
social.discordServer: Show the server address on Discord
social.discordServerHint: Otherwise Discord shows "Multiplayer". Private addresses (LAN, this PC) are never shown.

data.title: Your data
data.description: Your rights under the GDPR: access, portability and erasure.
data.exportHint: A JSON archive of your account, friends, purchases and settings.
data.exportFailed: The export could not be prepared
data.deleteHint: 30-day grace period during which you can cancel, then permanent deletion.
data.deleteScheduled: Deletion scheduled for {{date}}. Sign in before then to cancel.
data.deleteFailed: The account could not be deleted
data.rights: Questions or complaints: contact us, or the CNIL (the French data protection authority).
data.confirmBody: Your friends, cosmetics and purchases will be removed after 30 days. Your game licence and Microsoft account are not affected.

parental.title: Parental controls
parental.description: Rustic accounts are for ages {{age}} and up. For players under 18, purchases need a parent’s approval by default.
parental.minorNote: This account belongs to a minor: purchases ask for a parent’s approval.
parental.enableHint: Changes below then require the PIN.
parental.pinFirst: Create a PIN first to turn parental controls on.
parental.saveFailed: The change could not be saved

rules.title: Rules
rules.purchasesHint: Store purchases are cosmetic only. No loot boxes, ever.
rules.limitHint: Spent this month: {{spent}}. Leave empty for no limit.
rules.friendRequestsHint: Allow others to send friend requests.

pin.title: Parental PIN
pin.set: A PIN is set. It is needed to change these settings and approve purchases.
pin.hint: 4 to 6 digits, not a simple sequence.

errors.weak: Too easy to guess: avoid 1234 or 0000.

unlock.title: Locked
unlock.description: Enter the parental PIN to change these settings.
unlock.label: Parental PIN

about.title: Rustic Launcher
about.notAffiliated: Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
about.horizonCredit: Built on Horizon, an MIT-licensed Rust rewrite of the game, by its contributors.
about.company: Published by [company name], a French company (SIREN [number], [address]). Payments by Stripe; the company is the seller.
about.tagline: Rustic is a social game platform, powered by the Horizon engine

rusticAuth.mode: Sign in or create an account
rusticAuth.acceptPrivacy: I have read and accept the privacy policy.
rusticAuth.checkInbox: We sent a verification link to {{email}}. Open it, then sign in.

problems.username: Username: 3 to 20 letters, digits or underscore.
problems.tooYoung: Rustic accounts are for ages 13 and up.
problems.privacy: Accept the privacy policy to continue.

rusticAuth.microsoftWaiting: Finish signing in in your browser: the launcher picks up your session automatically.
